title: Zesty Crisp Argentinian Cheese Empanadas
description: A yeasty and crisp Argentinian dish featuring cheese slices, perfect for meal prep, and egg-free friendly. This recipe is great for a snack or lunch.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, yeast, salt, and sugar.
Gradually add warm water to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Place a cheese slice in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the cheese and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with olive oil and sprinkle with zesty seasoning.
Bake the empanadas in a preheated oven at 375 degrees for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve the empanadas warm and enjoy.
